text:
deploy-bot: kicking off config-only rollout: regional weights + batching cap. Canary 8% for 25m. Window 20:00-22:00 UTC. Patch: increase weight eu-north by +20, decrease us-west by -10, batch_max_tokens=20, per_router_concurrency=5, request_timeout_ms=1500. Health posts every 5m.

ana: reason is observed tail latency in eu, hoping weight shift + smaller batches reduce p99. No model version changes.

liam: exclude perf-test-namespace and tenant-big-io from canary. Also enable immediate drain on OOM.

infra-bot: exclusions applied: [perf-test-namespace, tenant-big-io]. OOM drain policy set.

rachel: rollback rules: abort if region p99 > 1100ms or total_error_rate increases by >1.2% absolute or infra OOMs >=2 in 10m. Also watch shard queue length.

ana: noted. ops snippet for runbook:
```yaml
change: config-only
canary: 8pct for 25m -> step to 30% if green
routing_weights:
  eu-north: +20
  us-west: -10
batching:
  max_tokens: 20
  per_router_concurrency: 5
timeouts_ms: 1500
exclude: [perf-test-namespace, tenant-big-io]
rollback_triggers:
  region_p99_ms: 1100
  error_rate_abs_pct: 1.2
  infra_ooms_10m: 2
```

deploy-bot: canary started 2026-06-03T20:01:51Z. Dash links: /dash/route-weights, /dash/batch-traces. Alerting to @rachel @ana.

(5m) infra-bot: health: eu-north p50 65ms p95 320ms p99 900ms, us-west p95 410ms, error_rate +0.2%. All within thresholds.

(18m) liam: one node hit OOM, drained, autoscaler recovered. No client-visible errors.

(26m) rachel: green to step to 30%. Proceeding to step-up.

ana: publishing short release note: "Config-only: favor eu-north via routing weight +20, reduce batch_max_tokens to 20, lower request timeout to 1500ms. Canary 8% -> 30% on green. Excluded perf-test-namespace and tenant-big-io. Rollback if region p99>1100ms, error rate +1.2% abs, or >=2 infra OOMs in 10m."

deploy-bot: commands available: `/deploybot abort-config` to revert, `/deploybot show-exclusions`. Next automated summary in 5m with flamegraphs and worst-sample logs.
